घुष् घो॑षति (घो॑ष˚ते) pp. घुष्ट sound, cry, call
out, proclaim. C. घोष॑यति cause to sound etc., also = S. —अव
proclaim aloud, offer. आ listen to;
 also = C. cry aloud, proclaim.
उद् sound, cry aloud. C. proclaim. वि make noise, sound, proclaim.
सम् sound, fill with noise, proclaim, praise, offer. — Cf. उड्घुष्ट
& परिसंघुष्ट.
